rationale: Protected-line positive-sequence magnitude is sqrt((80*0.08)^2 + (80*0.32)^2) = 26.387876 ohm. Zone 1 uses 80% underreach. Zone 2 covers the protected line plus 55% of the shortest backup line L_BC. Zone 3 covers the protected line plus 120% of the longest backup line L_BD and remains below the 0.8 load-encroachment limit of 121 ohm. Delays are inside the configured windows and nondecreasing.
